scope: Positive-reference observations only. Not precision, recall, holdout validation or parity.
intrabarPolicy: Only completed candles before eventTime are used. PriceApprox appends the reported signal price for RSI/close-based candidates; it does not reconstruct unknown intrabar H/L or exact exchange timestamp.
candidatePolicy: Fixed shipped-template defaults, no fitted thresholds. Pivot tie semantics and chart-vs-bot equivalence remain unverified.
